name: fskill
description: Lean engineering workflow skills and concise engineering principles for Codex, with explicit /f-mode session routing. Direct commands remain available.

interface.longDescription: fskill packages 9 lean engineering workflow skills (session routing, planning, debugging, review, UI, research, writing, handoff, and health) and shared engineering principles. think, hunt, and check also trigger when the task fits; the remaining six require an explicit call.
defaultPrompt: Use fskill think to plan this change
Use fskill check to review this diff
Use fskill hunt to debug this failure
